title: SRE practices
explain: Alert on user pain, not noise. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "SRE practices" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without SRE practices, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of SRE practices without a failure story
howToApply: Use SRE practices explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: PROMISE + BUDGET: SLO is the promise; error budget is the fuel for change.
useCases: Landing zone setup week: apply SRE practices so Dev/Test/Prod don't share blast radius.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “SRE practices” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “SRE practices”.

designTradeoffs.risk: You cannot fix what you cannot see
